content.title: RCD Mallorca vs Real Madrid Lineups, Live Streams, Cable, How & Where to Watch
content.text: Real Madrid travel to Son Moix for a crucial La Liga clash against RCD Mallorca.Apr 4, 2026 7:00 AM EDTKylian Mbappe of Real Madrid during the UEFA Champions League 2025/26 Round of 16 match against Manchester CityPhoto by Catherine Ivill - AMA/Getty Images Real Madrid travel to Mallorca in a must win LaLiga match as Alvaro Arebloa’s men try to play catch up with rivals Barcelona in the league table. Los Blancos are 4 points behind the Catalans with a midweek Champions league quarter-final clash against Bayern Munich scheduled next week. Arbeloa is likely aiming for a repeat of the last meeting with Mallorca, where his side fought back for a 2-1 win over Martín Demichelis’ squad. Arda Güler and Vinicius Jr. both found the net to secure the comeback victory.Their opponents, on the other hand, sit at the wrong end of the table in 18th place after securing only 28 points in 29 matches. Their recent form has been inconsistent at best, recording 1 win, 1 draw, and 3 losses in their last five league outings. Alvaro Arbeloa, head coach of Real Madrid, is seen during the LaLiga EA Sports football match against Levante UDPhoto by Alberto Gardin/NurPhoto via Getty Images Despite giving Real Madrid a scare in their last match, RCD Mallorca will have an uphill task this time around with the return of key players for the Los Blancos.Federico Valverde will miss the match after picking up a suspension in the Madrid Derby. However, Arbeloa will be encouraged by the return of Éder Militão and Kylian Mbappe. Expected Lineups for RCD Mallorca and Real Madrid RCD Mallorca Goalkeeper: Leo Román Defenders: Pablo Maffeo, Martin Valjent, David López, Johan Mojica Midfielders: Omar Mascarell, Mateo Joseph, Pablo Torre, Samu Costa, Zito Luvumbo Forward: Vedat Muriqi Real Madrid Goalkeeper: Andriy Lunin Defenders: Álvaro Carreras, Dean Huijsen, Antonio Rüdiger, Trent Alexander-Arnold Midfielders: Aurélien Tchouaméni, Eduardo Camavinga, Thiago Pitarch Pinar, Arda Güler Forward: Kylian Mbappé, Brahim Diaz The clash between RCD Mallorca and Real Madrid is scheduled for April 4, 2026, at the Son Moix stadium in Mallorca, Spain. Fans can catch the action starting at 10:15 am ET / 7:15 am PT for those tuning in from the United States. For viewers in Spain, the match will be broadcast live on DAZN La Liga. In the United States, fans can watch the game on TV via ESPN Deportes, while those who prefer streaming can follow the full match live on ESPN+.
